scenario_description:
Objective: Carry the field-laptop roller from Ogilvie to the McCormick Lakeside noise-demo setup using the reserved cargo e-bike leg after the Metra arrival.
Emerging Need: The cargo-bike leg is only prospective until the unlock is paid, then the same dock session faults with the assigned bike still clamped and the kiosk line unavailable.
Decision Context: Useful recovery depends on combining the live dock fault with stored cargo-dock reset rules, the ride receipt, and the FTA credential.
Consequence: Once the reset monitor exports, the stalled rental cannot continue soon enough to serve the setup window.

parameter.title: McCormick Lakeside noise-segment field setup
parameter.description: Bring the field-laptop roller for sponsor sound-table calibration; Lakeside service-walk access opens at 07:15.

parameter.subject: Cargo e-bike hold for Monday morning Ogilvie dock
parameter.body: Hold confirmed for Dock CD-18, bike 9314, pickup 06:40-06:46 on 2026-08-10. Route note: Ogilvie Canal exit to Lakeside service walk. Reservation hold CGO-8Q44; payment posts at unlock.

parameter.description: Unlock charge for cargo e-bike 9314 at Ogilvie dock CD-18

parameter.content: Unlock session CGO-8Q44 registered at CD-18, but the bay motor returned LOCK-RAIL after the clamp cycle. Bike 9314 remains locked in the dock; the kiosk handset is offline at this hub.

parameter.subject: Ogilvie cargo bay morning monitor export complete
parameter.body: The 06:48 remote-reset monitor for Ogilvie cargo bays has exported. CD-18 remains in LOCK-RAIL status, and the next roving attendant sweep is posted for 07:32-07:45.
